TBIM and TBEM tabs: Revit, IFC (with IfcZones), Topologic, Honeybee and EnergyPlus models

faces: Massing models as CellComplexes: one cell per room, faces classified by topology
controllers: Storeys, walls, floors, roofs and spaces created in Revit from the faces
cells: Occupancy types, internal loads and set-points of every cell
types: Layered Revit types with real materials, from tuff masonry to curtain walls
apertures: Windows and doors placed on the faces by rules
graph: Dual graph of the cells: door, wall and slab connections
data: Data back to Revit - here the U-values of the envelope
zones: Cells grouped in thermal zones - also Revit HVAC zones and IfcZones
boundaries: Boundary conditions from the topology: outdoors, ground, adjacent zones
heating: Heating need of the zones (Full TBEM, EnergyPlus, Bologna) - dark red is high
cooling: Cooling need of the zones - from pale yellow (low) to dark red (high)
charts: Spatial BEM, Topological BEM and Full TBEM: same building, more information
orbit: Exported as Revit, IFC (property sets, IfcZones), Topologic, Honeybee and EnergyPlus models
